messages:
jules: Customer report — promo code 'SPRINGFREE2026' rejected as "invalid" on Android app v3.2.1 but redeems fine on web. Customer email: alice@example.com. They attached screenshot and request id r-523ab. Can someone take a look?

nina: Got it, what's the ticket number and any logs from the client?

jules: Ticket #4572 opened. Customer sent this error in-app: {"error":"promo.invalid","code":"SPRINGFREE2026","request_id":"r-523ab"}

billing-bot: Promo-validate service: lookup returned 404 for code "SPRINGFREE2026" tenant=redwood-prod request_id=r-523ab

taylor: I checked the promo dashboard — code exists, active, not expired, 500 redeems remaining. Likely client-side encoding issue :thinking_face:

aditya: On mobile, some keyboards or copy/paste can insert invisible characters (ZWSP U+200B). Can we see the raw request body that the Android client sent?

jules: Pasted raw request body from logs: {"code":"SPRINGFREE2026<U+200B>","platform":"android","app_version":"3.2.1"}

taylor: Bingo — there's a trailing U+200B (zero-width space). Android copy from email likely introduced it. Server validation uses strict equality so it fails.

kevin: We should sanitize incoming promo codes in the validation service (trim + unicode-normalize + strip hidden chars). I'll add a hotfix middleware to do this ASAP. @aditya can you add tests?

nina: Meanwhile support can issue a one-time sanitized code or add manual credit. Recommend $20 manual credit and send sanitized code to unblock customer.

taylor: Done — issued $20 manual credit to alice@example.com and created one-time code SPRINGFREE2026-1 (expires in 7d). Notified customer :white_check_mark:

jules: Customer confirmed the new code worked on Android. They're unblocked and happy. Closing ticket.

kevin: Filed internal bug BR-987 to add sanitization to promo API. ETA deploy 48h. @aditya please include unit test for ZWSP, BOM, and nonbreaking spaces.

aditya: Will add sanitizer module. Quick patch applied in validation service for now: code = code.replace(/<U+200B>/g, '').normalize('NFKC').trim();

support-bot: Ticket #4572 closed by jules — resolution: manual credit + reissue. :tada:

jules: Also adding KB note: "Promo codes copied from mobile mailers can include invisible chars — strip before validation." Link: https://internal.redwood.ai/kb/promos-mobile-copy-paste
